question: 当前股价比曲线的最高和最低点的平均值高多少？

steps.description: Locate the lowest point on the stock price curve and read its value
Locate the highest point on the stock price curve and read its value
Calculate the average of the highest and lowest point values from step_1 and step_2
Locate the current stock price value on the chart and read it
Calculate the difference between the current stock price from step_4 and the average from step_3
